card.name: Inside the word discontinue
card.fires_on: The last piece of 'discontinue' or 'discontinuation' when a drug label says to stop a medicine, often right after 'permanently dis' or 'Interventions include discontin'.

modes.label: Permanently discontinue
modes.description: The ending of 'discontinue' after 'Permanently dis' in dose-modification tables, just before a drug name.
modes.example: Severe cutaneous adverse reactions (SCARs) Permanently dis<<continue>> MEKINIST.

modes.label: Discontinuation as treatment
modes.description: The ending of 'discontinuation' in overdose or reaction management lists, just before 'of' plus the drug.
modes.example: Treatment of overdosage consists of discontin<<uation>> of cladribine, careful observation,
